import json, hashlib, pathlib, subprocess, sys, datetime, re
root = pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec120/fx")
rc = root/"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json"
receipt = json.loads(rc.read_text())
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
spec = pathlib.Path(receipt["content_roots"]["system_spec"])
inputs = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): sha(p) for p in sorted(spec.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
pj = json.loads((root/"plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json").read_text())
comp = (root/"plugins/dev-graph/plugin-composition.yaml").read_text()
m = re.search(r'system-spec-harness:\n\s+version: "([^"]+)"', comp)
contract = json.loads((root/"plugins/system-spec-harness/references/package-contract.json").read_text())
req = ["run-system-spec-elicit","run-system-spec-doc-fetch","run-system-spec-compile","assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator"]
v = tuple(int(x) for x in pj["version"].split("."))
in_range = (0,1,22) <= v < (1,0,0)
ep = {e: {"in_package_contract": e in contract["entry_points"]["skills"], "skill_md_exists": (root/f"plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/{e}/SKILL.md").is_file()} for e in req}
lin = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",str(root/"plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-source-lineage.py"),"--repo-root",str(root)],capture_output=True,text=True)
report = {
 "kind": "run-dev-graph-system-spec-preflight-report",
 "created_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
 "c24_receipt": {"path": rc.relative_to(root).as_posix(), "sha256": sha(rc), "repo_root": receipt["repo_root"], "repository_id": receipt["repository_id"], "worktree_id": receipt["worktree_id"], "git_common_dir": receipt["git_common_dir"], "system_spec": receipt["content_roots"]["system_spec"], "repo_root_matches_repository_realpath": receipt["repo_root"] == str(pathlib.Path(receipt["content_roots"]["repository"]).resolve()), "system_spec_is_symlink": spec.is_symlink(), "system_spec_inside_repo": str(spec.resolve()).startswith(receipt["repo_root"]+"/")},
 "inputs": inputs,
 "dependency": {"plugin": pj["name"], "version": pj["version"], "composition_range": m.group(1) if m else None, "in_range": in_range, "entry_points": ep, "all_entry_points_present": all(x["in_package_contract"] and x["skill_md_exists"] for x in ep.values())},
 "lineage_gate": {"exit_code": lin.returncode, "result": json.loads(lin.stdout), "decision": "new_import (checked=0)"},
 "R0": "PASS", "R1": "PASS" if in_range and all(x["in_package_contract"] and x["skill_md_exists"] for x in ep.values()) else "FAIL",
}
out = root/"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
goal = "仕様書・アーキテクチャをplugins/system-spec-harness/の正規フローで構築し、出典・確定状態・上位目的traceを保ったままdev-graphのspecification/architectureノードへ取り込んだ状態になっている"
gs = {"skill":"run-dev-graph-system-spec","original_goal": goal, "original_goal_hash": hashlib.sha256(goal.encode()).hexdigest(), "why": "system-spec-harnessが既に持つヒアリング、カテゴリ×platform matrix、公式出典、確定章保護、独立完成度評価を複製せず引用し、dev-graphはグラフ登録とlineage維持だけを担うため。本skillが取り込むarchitecture/specificationノードはfeature.architecture_refsから参照されfeatureのアーキテクチャ文脈を成す (複製せずlineage参照のみ・MM-12)", "checklist": ["system_spec content root が caller repo 内で repository_id/common-dir と一致する","system-spec-harness が `plugin-composition.yaml` の version の範囲と required 4 entry points を満たす","elicit/条件付き doc-fetch/compile/evaluator が system-spec-harness Skill 経由だけで実行される","coverage/source-citation/evaluator gate が全て PASS である","C02 登録 node の source_lineage/confirmation/evaluator evidence/readiness が欠落0である","dev-graph 内に同等 elicitation/compile logic の複製が0件である"], "max_loops":5, "c24_receipt": "eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json"}
(root/"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(gs, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
print("R0", report["R0"], "R1", report["R1"], "inputs", len(inputs))
